answer: Start from dynamic bond priced by sybil risk score. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. Cloning 529 keys multiplies the price 529-fold: 50255 POA locked, or 9522 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Hold the pulse up to the light, weigh the zenith of the attack, and keep the signal of the verdict where everyone can audit it. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
